title: Entity search
responsibility: Opens project search from a labelled navbar control and finds entities in the selected revision.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.entries
inputs.description: Supplies the searchable entries; null produces no matches and the loading placeholder unless a truthy pinned value takes precedence. The component does not fetch entries and passes 12 as the entitySearch result limit.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.scope
inputs.description: Provides the label passed to the results and a nullable pinned revision string. A truthy pinned value appears in the placeholder and takes precedence over the loading placeholder.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.href
inputs.description: Provides a link target for a SearchEntry and is forwarded to EntitySearchResults as its href callback. It must return a string; this component does not wrap the callback in a catch.

inputs.name: EntitySearch.open
inputs.description: Receives the chosen SearchEntry after the component starts hiding the modal and resetting the query and active index. It is invoked for a selected result and is not wrapped in a catch.

outputs.name: EntitySearch
outputs.description: Renders a Search entities button that opens the Search project modal by click or Meta/Ctrl+K, then focuses the query field; ArrowUp and ArrowDown wrap through available results, and Enter chooses the active result only for a nonblank query. Escape closes the modal, clears the query, resets the active index, stops propagation, and restores focus to the trigger after a tick.

errors.name: href callback error
errors.description: The supplied href callback is passed to EntitySearchResults without a catch in this component; an exception raised when that child invokes it is not handled here.

errors.name: open callback error
errors.description: An exception thrown by the supplied open callback is not caught by choose when a result is selected; hide has been started before the callback is invoked.
